title: A Restaurant Review
text:
Last week I ate at Luna, a small restaurant near my school. The soup was hot and the bread was fresh. The waiter was friendly and quick. I liked the atmosphere a lot.

However, the pasta was cold and the room was too noisy. The prices were high for the small portions. I would give Luna three stars out of five.

paragraph_translations: La semana pasada comí en Luna, un pequeño restaurante cerca de mi escuela. La sopa estaba caliente y el pan estaba fresco. El camarero era amable y rápido. Me gustó mucho el ambiente.
Sin embargo, la pasta estaba fría y la sala era demasiado ruidosa. Los precios eran altos para las porciones pequeñas. Le daría a Luna tres estrellas de cinco.
